description: ADSR envelope generator with a slider and a control voltage input for each stage, and a separate signal path through an attenuverter and an offset

params.text: Attenuates and inverts the signal on its way to the OUT jack
Adds a voltage between -5V and 5V to the signal on its way to the OUT jack
Sets the attack time, the climb from zero to the maximum level
Sets the decay time, the fall from the maximum level to the sustain level
Sets the sustain level the envelope holds while the gate stays high
Sets the release time, the fall to zero once the gate goes low
Raises the gate by hand for as long as the button is held
Picks the range of every stage time: FAST runs from 1ms to 4 seconds, SLOW from 8ms to 40 seconds
In NORM the voltage at the A CV input is passed on to the D and R inputs as well, so one cable controls the whole timing; in INDEP each control voltage input reaches only its own stage

inputs.text: While this input is high the envelope runs through attack and decay and holds at the sustain level; when it goes low the release begins
A trigger here sends the envelope through attack and decay again while the gate is high; with nothing patched it takes the GATE input
The signal into the attenuverter and offset; with nothing patched the ENV output is fed to it
Modulates the attack time, summed with the A slider; voltages below 0V and above 5V reach beyond the slider's own range
Modulates the decay time, summed with the D slider; voltages below 0V and above 5V reach beyond the slider's own range
Modulates the sustain level, summed with the S slider; voltages below 0V and above 5V reach beyond the slider's own range
Modulates the release time, summed with the R slider; voltages below 0V and above 5V reach beyond the slider's own range

outputs.text: High whenever the envelope is in none of its stages, so it goes high once the envelope has finished and stays high until the next trigger
The signal from the SIG input after the attenuverter and the offset

notes: the envelope stays at zero until a gate arrives at the GATE input or the gate button is held down.

inputs.1:
stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the gate input.
inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the envelope output.
